name: devdigest/run-plan
summary: Runs an approved Development Plan autonomously: implementers by the plan's dependency graph and owned paths, then architecture-reviewer and plan-verifier in parallel, then a bounded fix loop, then a report and a /pr-self-review recommendation. Spec, plan and test-writer are run separately. Usage: /run-plan plan:plans/<slug>.md [mode:single|multi] [max-fix:N].
